headline: Revenue growth accelerates as profitability swings higher
summary_short: Revenue rose 25% year over year to $647.4M on Active Member and Purchase Volume growth, and net income reached $53.5M as Adjusted EBITDA margin expanded to 18% from 5%.
summary_long: Revenue grew 25% y/y to $647.4M on Active Member growth (+19% y/y to 10.2M), Purchase Volume growth (+12% y/y to $38.7B), and a mix shift toward credit-card interchange. Platform-related revenue rose 50% y/y on MyPay's new variable-pricing plan and Instant Loans. Net income reached $53.5M and Adjusted EBITDA hit $118.6M (18% margin, up from 5%), helped by lower MyPay loss rates and operating leverage, partly offset by higher stock-based compensation tied to 2025 IPO vesting. The company repurchased $85.7M of Class A shares and held $607.7M of cash plus $403.6M of marketable securities against $443.6M of unused credit-facility capacity. No forward guidance was issued in the filing.
